title: Catalog
description: A catalogue of a government's published datasets, aligned with DCAT and expressed as a schema.org DataCatalog. DCAT is the international standard here (DCAT-AP in the EU, DCAT-US in the States, and the basis of most national open-data portals), and schema.org DataCatalog is what Google Dataset Search consumes - so this projection has an immediate real consumer rather than a hypothetical one.

description.description: A plain-language description of what this catalogue covers.

url.description: Where this catalogue's canonical human-readable page lives.

identifier.description: Any scheme-qualified identifiers for this catalogue beyond its `@id`.

license.description: The default licence for datasets in this catalogue, where one applies to all of them.

inLanguage.description: The language(s) this catalogue is published in.

contactPoint.description: How to reach the publisher with questions about this catalogue.
